Quadratic vote pricing gates paid-task admission. Casting v votes for one candidate costs v squared credits, and votes count only from distinct origin clusters.
Flow: candidates join the atlas registry, the contract prices each ballot set, and admission needs 3 distinct-cluster votes plus a velvet-tier escrow of 0.50 units locked for 12 epochs.
Cost: N sybils vote once each, none reaching the 3-vote bar; concentrating 12 votes on one fake identity costs 144 credits versus 3 for honest entry, and the sable-class auditor rejects forged origins.
